name: Fluxknight - AI Sales & Lead Qualification - Multi Tenant v2

parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json; const required=['organization_id','agent_id','idempotency_key','channel','event_type','input']; const missing=required.filter(k=>b[k]===undefined||b[k]===null||b[k]===''); if(missing.length) throw new Error('Missing required tenant fields: '+missing.join(', ')); const allowed=['whatsapp','email','web_chat','telegram','voice','internal']; if(!allowed.includes(b.channel)) throw new Error('Unsupported channel'); const input=b.input||{}; const customerKey=String(b.customer_id||input.customer_key||input.email||input.phone||input.customer?.email||input.customer?.phone||'').trim(); if(!customerKey) throw new Error('customer_id or customer identifier required'); return [{json:{organization_id:String(b.organization_id),agent_id:String(b.agent_id),conversation_id:b.conversation_id||null,customer_id:b.customer_id||null,customer_key:customerKey,idempotency_key:String(b.idempotency_key),channel:b.channel,event_type:b.event_type,external_thread_key:b.external_thread_key||input.external_thread_key||null,input,received_at:new Date().toISOString(),workflow_key:'ai_sales_qualification_v2'}}];

const env=$('Validate Tenant Envelope').first().json; const executionId=$('Queue Runtime Execution').first().json.execution_id; const schema={qualification_status:'hot|warm|cold|disqualified',score:'0-100 integer',stage:'new|qualified|contacted|nurturing|appointment|disqualified',intent:'string',need:'string',budget:'string|null',timeline:'string|null',location:'string|null',objections:['string'],missing_fields:['name|email|phone|company|budget|timeline|need'],appointment_requested:'boolean',requested_datetime:'ISO datetime|null',handoff_required:'boolean',handoff_reason:'string|null',summary:'string',reply:'string',memory_facts:[{type:'preference|fact|goal|objection',summary:'string',confidence:'0-1'}]}; return [{json:{...env,execution_id:executionId,provider_input:{message:env.input.message||env.input.text||'',customer:env.input.customer||{},lead_context:env.input.lead_context||env.input,channel:env.channel,event_type:env.event_type},output_schema:schema}}];

const ctx=$('Build Provider Request').first().json; let raw=String($json.output_text||'').replace(/^```json\s*/i,'').replace(/```$/,'').trim(); let q; try{q=JSON.parse(raw)}catch(e){throw new Error('Invalid AI JSON: '+raw.slice(0,300))} const statuses=['hot','warm','cold','disqualified']; const stages=['new','qualified','contacted','nurturing','appointment','disqualified']; q.qualification_status=statuses.includes(q.qualification_status)?q.qualification_status:'warm'; q.score=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,Math.round(Number(q.score)||0))); q.stage=stages.includes(q.stage)?q.stage:(q.score>=70?'qualified':q.score>=35?'nurturing':'new'); q.appointment_requested=Boolean(q.appointment_requested); q.handoff_required=Boolean(q.handoff_required); q.objections=Array.isArray(q.objections)?q.objections:[]; q.missing_fields=Array.isArray(q.missing_fields)?q.missing_fields:[]; q.memory_facts=Array.isArray(q.memory_facts)?q.memory_facts:[]; return [{json:{...ctx,qualification:q,provider_usage:$json.usage||{},provider_response_id:$json.response_id||null,provider:$json.provider,model:$json.model}}];

const r=$json; const actions=[]; if(r.handoff_required) actions.push({type:'handoff',payload:r.handoff}); if(r.appointment_required) actions.push({type:'appointment',payload:r.appointment}); if(r.follow_up_required) actions.push({type:'follow_up',payload:r.follow_up}); if(r.reply_action) actions.push({type:'reply',payload:r.reply_action}); return [{json:{...r,actions}}];
